source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At the start of each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) you may choose one of the two imperatives below; until that round ends it applies to your army, and every unit of yours with this ability gains its effects. **PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE**: the unit's ranged weapons gain **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)** and their Ballistic Skill improves by 1; while the unit is BATTLELINE itself or has another ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE unit of yours no more than 6" away, melee attacks aimed at it subtract 1 from their Hit rolls. **CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE**: its ranged weapons gain **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** and the Weapon Skill of its melee weapons improves by 1; under that same BATTLELINE condition, each attack its models make has its Armour Penetration improved by 1.
